preconditions.description: The length of the guessed string n is between 2 and 100 inclusive.
There are exactly 2n-2 prefixes and suffixes.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= n-1 for s in prefixes_and_suffixes)
preconditions.description: Each prefix and suffix has a length between 1 and n-1 inclusive.
Each prefix and suffix consists only of lowercase Latin letters.
Each string of length from 1 to n-1 appears exactly twice in the input.

postconditions.description: The output string has a length of 2n-2.
The number of 'P' characters is equal to the number of 'S' characters in the output string.

postconditions.expression: all(c in 'PS' for c in result)
postconditions.description: The output string consists only of characters 'P' and 'S'.
